title: Rav Ravai of Rov
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was one of the Savoraim. He was from the town of Rov near Nehardea and lived for many years, as cited in the [Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon, part 2, end of chapter 4](https://www.sefaria.org/Epistle_of_Rav_Sherira_Gaon.1.111).[^1]

He is also mentioned in the Gemara, [Sanhedrin 43a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.43a.10), according to [Rabbeinu Chananel’s](https://www.sefaria.org/Rabbeinu_Chananel_on_Sanhedrin.43a.3) reading, saying: “It is reasonable [that it is paid] from public funds.”[^2]

notes.text: The linked Epistle calls Rav Ravai a member of the academy and reports that he was a Gaon. Hyman cites a different division of the letter and adds the geographical and longevity details.
The linked Bavli gives the answer anonymously. Rabbeinu Chananel names Rav Ravai of Rov as the one who explained that the community pays.
